templates.name: Design Review Checklist
templates.description: Pre-fabrication review checklist for PCB layout verification
templates.content:
# PCB Design Review Checklist

## Board
<!-- Board name and revision -->

## Schematic vs Layout
- [ ] Netlist matches schematic
- [ ] All components placed
- [ ] No unconnected nets

## Design Rules
- [ ] DRC passes with zero errors
- [ ] Trace widths meet current requirements
- [ ] Clearances meet voltage requirements

## Manufacturing
- [ ] Drill sizes within fab capability
- [ ] Silkscreen legible and correct
- [ ] Fiducials placed for SMT assembly
- [ ] Panelization considered

## Signal Integrity
- [ ] High-speed traces impedance controlled
- [ ] Decoupling caps near IC power pins
- [ ] Ground plane unbroken under critical traces
